authority: Direct owner request in the project chat
request: Place an explosive at one fixed point between the lobby's destructible columns, trigger it with a button, measure and record performance, then provide a detailed plan for improving destruction so future levels can support substantial destruction.
reported_symptom: The thrown grenade reduces performance from more than 120 FPS to approximately 25 FPS.
authorized_now: Implement a repeatable fixed-position button-triggered blast fixture
Run and preserve focused performance measurements and diagnostic comparisons
Write a detailed optimization and production-scaling plan
future_only: The optimization plan is proposed work; this request does not authorize executing all of its implementation stages.
preservation: Preserve the owner's current map, grenade asset, configuration edits and prior evidence. Final gameplay and visual acceptance belong to the owner.
